name: Aika
source:
The innocent and angelic member of the class. Despite her soft and shy nature, she has an obscene body. She is a maternal girl that loves to make sweets, and is seen as the ideal wife.

She has a hard time controlling the class due to her gentle nature, but they are able to get along because of her.
